relationship: Additional user priorities mapped to the unchanged 30 source attributes; not a replacement or a new 30-item taxonomy.

priorities.acceptance_observation: Each next action has an actual owner or explicit missing owner, input, output, scope and observable done condition.
Compare the existing process and the smallest adequate change; reject features whose upkeep or review burden exceeds their benefit.
Exercise the real provider request/response contract and retain source IDs, versions and error semantics.
Produce an executable configuration or patch and target-host evidence, or a precise blocker and completed independent work.
Replay eligible runs from preserved fictional inputs, versions, settings, commands and declared tolerances.
Repeat comparable tasks and report factual consistency, variation, failures and rework.
Assess routine and failure cases with frozen references and explicit denominators; do not generalise a small pass set.
Show a defensible total-cost and maintenance case against the current alternative before routine adoption.
Verify actual memory, model/context, tools, permissions and available time on the intended device.
Obtain Will's observed judgement that the output addresses a real need and reduces burden; a creator's score is insufficient.
Separate transferable files from host-specific operation and test another host before claiming support.
Trace material claims to eligible evidence, disclose uncertainty and avoid maturity claims beyond actual checks.
Retain a known working revision and run regression, restart and recovery checks before replacing it.
Keep decision, execution, review and repair ownership explicit, with actual permissions and a correction route.
Turn failures into versioned regression cases; test candidate changes, support rollback and qualify transfers without autonomous policy expansion.
